text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":6000,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"space for 6000 people"},{"id":"q2","value":950,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"950 seats for graduates"},{"id":"q3","value":300,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"300 seats for faculty"}],"plan":[{"op":"add","args":["q2","q3"],"out":"s1","note":"add graduate seats (950) and faculty seats (300) together"},{"op":"sub","args":["q1","s1"],"out":"s2","note":"subtract that from the total venue capacity (6000) to find seats left for friends and family"},{"op":"div","args":["s2","q2"],"out":"s3","note":"divide the remaining seats by the number of graduates (950, same as graduate seats) to find tickets each graduate receives"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"tickets each graduate receives for friends and family"},"dismissed":[]}
